<b>Thief's Mark</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Yellow|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It increases [[Rosary]] drops from defeated enemies, but causes [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to lose some Rosaries when taking damage.

== Usefulness ==
When equipped, enemies drop extra [[Rosaries]] when defeated. These rosaries glow white when dropped, but fade colour after about half a second. The total amount of rosaries is based on the type of bead dropped, rounded up:
* Regular [[File:Rosaries large.png|20x20px|link=Rosaries|Regular Rosaries]] beads are multiplied by 1.4 (+40%)
* Shell [[File:Shell Rosaries large.png|20x20px|link=Rosaries|Shell Rosaries]] beads are multiplied by 1.3 (+30%)
* Pearl [[File:Pearl Rosaries large.png|20x20px|link=Rosaries|Pearl Rosaries]] beads are multiplied by 1.2 (+20%)

However, when Hornet takes damage, she has a 30% chance of losing 3-5% of her held Rosaries, rounded up, capping out at 10-20 Rosaries depending on percentage. 
* Multi-hit attacks still have a 30% chance total to drop Rosaries, but the amount changes to 6-10% with a cap of 15-30 Rosaries.
* 1-3 Rosaries lost are dropped on the ground, giving Hornet the chance to get them back. The rest will break when dropped.

[[Snitchfly|Snitchflies]] do not attack Hornet when Thief's Mark is equipped, unless Hornet attacks them first. The Snitchflies in their [[Blasted Steps]] hideout will also no longer hide when Hornet enters there.

Any rosaries lost in an [[Elegy of the Deep]] Memory or in the [[First Sinner]] fight will be returned to her upon leaving.

== How To Acquire ==
Purchased from [[Grindle]] in [[Blasted Steps]] for {{R|350}}.
